parsed.rationale: I read this as sinus rhythm with narrow QRS complexes and no bundle branch block or pre-excitation; the ST elevation in V2-V4 is concave with tall T waves and large QRS voltage, which fits a benign early repolarization pattern. It does not show the convex, regional ST elevation with reciprocal changes that STEMI requires. This is a visual read of one image, so a clinical correlation with symptoms and serial ECGs or troponin is still needed.
